scope: ARM64 Data.span isolated experiment qualification and timing
controls: Intentional wrong-output/statistics controls are preserved under arm64/controls/negative-{files,stdin}; those expected rejections are successful harness qualification.
no_rerun_or_discard: All fixed six-pair follow-ups remain separate from primary measurements.
limitations: Six paired samples per configuration and phase; no startup or cold-cache claims.
Linux documentation qualification is the Core symbol graph; Mac supplies DocC.
Both B/P retain Foundation and the same direct shared-library dependencies.
Standalone strict-memory-safety probe is not package-wide strict-memory-safety qualification.

reporting_failures.resolution: Read actual label field in final-validation step receipts; no source, qualification, audit or measurement changed.
